name: quality-kernel
description: A quality-assurance kernel for agentic development. Wraps the existing SDD + orchestration pipeline with a six-agent SwarmForge-style engine (Specifier -> Coder -> Cleaner -> Architect -> Hardener -> QA), deterministic quality tools (mutation, CRAP, DRY), a blind live-oracle verifier, and epistemic-discipline gates. Guarantees analyze -> implement -> test -> deliver with a declared residual, from a one-line issue to a large feature.
